name: aperture
title: Aperture
description: The next section opens through a growing circle (an iris) as you scroll into it, from a small porthole to full bleed.

meta.reducedMotion: The section is fully open from the start.
meta.useWhen: A chapter change that is a real threshold: entering a room, a lens, a window, a reveal of the product.
meta.avoidWhen: Every section; content that must be readable at the edges before the iris opens.
